independentProbes.name: maximum source/field lengths preserve retrieval and provenance
independentProbes.method: Accept exactly 32000 OCR characters with relevant tail and 60 unique grounded 300-character fields. Revise all 60 to 300 characters and confirm; assert retrieval succeeds, original blocks/quotes/extracted values preserved. Reject 32001 OCR characters and 301-character field. Injected service knowledge ignored.

reviewedBehavior: Analysis reads/starts/reviews join evidence and cases with the same user owner, active evidence status and nonarchived case; analysis queries always bind user_id.
Concurrent starts have one atomic SQL claim per evidence_id; explicit retry is required for failed analyses; original SHA-256 verified before sending bytes.
Results update an existing run only and require current owned active evidence with matching content_hash; deletion/archival or a different run cannot revive a result.

Deletion atomically records durable cancellation, marks deleting, captures job_id and deletes analyses. A late upload is cleaned without restoring a cancelled UUID. Database cancellation failures roll back without deleting original bytes.
A job arriving after deletion/archival fails attachment and is best-effort cancelled. A job arriving before deletion is captured inside the deletion transaction.

Service/model result knowledge is discarded. Grounded fields require known key, valid same-page ordered block references, exact quote in cited OCR text and value in quote; invalid fields are dropped with warnings.

Field labels come from fixed server mapping. Human corrections retain extractedValue/quote/blockIds/origin and store confirmed independently of corrected review status. Stale revisions return 409 without overwriting saved data.

OCR total is capped at 32000, fields at 60 x 300, retrieval at 60000, manual knowledge API at 2000; no silent tail truncation. Material panel maxLength is 300 and honors persisted corrected+confirmed state.

Public retrieval returns only recognized legal concepts in displayed query, exact frozen case/provision source paragraphs, HTTPS URLs, fingerprint and original version status notes. No relevant terms produce empty hits; selected historic/repealed boundaries are preserved.

UI handles source text as React text, links only HTTP(S), displays OCR/rules vs model engine identity, preserves correction drafts on conflict, aborts stale requests and keys material panels by case/evidence.

HTTP runner creates a temporary database/bucket state directory and private mode-0600 config, suppresses credential-bearing Wrangler output, binds loopback, and cleans worker/service/temp state. Regression inputs are explicitly synthetic and owner headers are isolated test identities.
Final deletion feedback says temporary processing material cleanup is unconfirmed when processingCleanupPending=true; it does not assume all failures are offline or guarantee expiry cleans files.

limitations: This is independent source/API review with isolated controlled-service checks, not proof of OCR quality or real model inference. OCR text can itself be wrong; exact quote grounding does not establish material authenticity or legal applicability.

The final extraction service was excluded per delegation. Its actual DELETE cancellation, temporary-file cleanup, 15-minute expiry and model/engine reporting must be verified on its own final source hashes by main/service reviewer.

Existing output/materials/http-production.json describes earlier synthetic PNG/PDF real OCR rules tests and an earlier build. It was read as background only; it is not accepted as final candidate HTTP/model evidence.
The final integrated Worker build, isolated TXT/images/model HTTP flow, client-bundle boundary, browser lifecycle and repository npm run check remain main-agent integration responsibilities.

Production identity relies on the preexisting trusted Sites authentication header contract. This review verifies owner-bound API behavior using isolated supplied identities, and does not validate a deployed gateway preventing caller-forged identity headers.

Archival hides analysis access and preserves underlying data; it is not deletion. Unreachable or unknown local jobs can retain bounded temporary cache until service expiry/close. A cancelled late job is best-effort and cannot make an already completed DELETE response retroactively report cleanup status.

Incremental HTTP script review binds final script hashes and validates fixture assertions/FAIL diagnostics only. The preserved real Apple output failed manual semantic review; new extraction quality requires final service/model HTTP evidence and cannot be inferred from the earlier API or transport passes.
